SELECT
  t0.data_center,
  t0.zone,
  t0.row,
  t0.cabinet,
  t0.cabinet_id,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_max_height) AS cabinet_max_height_ru,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_occupied_height) AS cabinet_occupied_height_ru,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_remaining_height) AS cabinet_remaining_height_ru,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_max_watts) AS cabinet_max_watts,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_nominal_watts) AS cabinet_nominal_watts,
  MAX(t0.cabinet_max_watts) - MAX(t0.cabinet_nominal_watts) AS power_headroom_watts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t0.device_label) AS device_count,
  SUM(COALESCE(t0.device_nominal_watts, 0)) AS total_device_nominal_watts
FROM opendcim.opendcim_info AS t0
WHERE t0.data_center = 'XAP'
GROUP BY
  t0.data_center,
  t0.zone,
  t0.row,
  t0.cabinet,
  t0.cabinet_id
ORDER BY t0.row, t0.cabinet
LIMIT 1001;

input.narrative: Cabinet-level view for XAP (29 cabinets): all racks are 42 RU; three cabinets are effectively full on space (H-08 at 0 RU remaining; E-01 and G-03 at 2 RU remaining). Power headroom is largest in H-06 (21_800 W), F-07 (21_700 W), and E-08 (20_960 W); smallest in C-06 (6_000 W) and H-03 (7_400 W). Most cabinets still have double-digit kW headroom—22 of 29 exceed 9_000 W available. Space and power are not aligned in a few spots: H-08 is out of RU yet has 17_000 W free, suggesting either placeholders or inaccurate height reporting. Use this table to target adds in high-headroom cabinets and remediate space-only constraints in H-08 and near-full cabinets E-01 and G-03.

        row,
        row_id,
        cabinet_id,
        MAX(cabinet_max_height) AS cabinet_max_height,

        MAX(cabinet_remaining_height) AS cabinet_remaining_height,
        MAX(cabinet_max_watts) AS cabinet_max_watts,

    GROUP BY data_center, row, row_id, cabinet_id

SELECT t0.target, t0.rule_id, t1.rule_details, t0.status, t0.update_datetime, t0.uuid
FROM redfishdb.alert_metrics t0
JOIN redfishdb.alert_rules t1 ON t0.rule_id = t1.rule_id
WHERE t0.data_center = 'SgpDC'
  AND lower(t1.rule_details) LIKE '%fan%'
ORDER BY t0.update_datetime DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT rule_id, rule_details, severity, frequency
FROM redfishdb.alert_rules
WHERE lower(rule_details) LIKE '%fan%'
ORDER BY rule_id
LIMIT 50;
